inventory.description: Independent first PNG pixel observation, before reading modern text: one sphere outline, solid on the left and lower portion, dashed on the upper/right portion behind the plane. No grid, scale, numerical values or subfigures. The two exact arcs form one silhouette. Their joins are regularized at the projected plane boundary; join coordinates are not source measurements.

First PNG pixels show visible points A upper right, O central and B lower left, labels A/O/B, and a dashed straight AB through O. A and B are inside the projected silhouette, not points on its 2D outline. Modern text confirms A is contact, O center and AB diameter. Spatial coordinates are authored regularization, not scanned coordinates; physical radius facts use the unprojected meridian assertions and the executable spatial check.

First PNG pixels show an oblique four-edge plane patch, plane label alpha, solid line through A between opposite patch edges with label a, and no printed right-angle mark. Modern text binds alpha tangent at A, AB perpendicular to alpha and line a lying in alpha through A. Orthographic spatial construction retains these relationships without falsely asserting a right angle in the projected picture. No extra source points or answer annotations are introduced.
